paper.title: The Gossiping Insert-Eliminate Algorithm for Multi-Agent Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized multi-agent MAB with pairwise gossip communication and communication budget
unmapped: N agents play the same K-armed instance and receive independent rewards (no collisions)
agents pull information (an O(log NK)-bit message) from a random agent drawn from an unknown gossip matrix P (irreducible, Assumption A.1)
communication budget B_t: at most B_t information pulls in the first t slots, B_t = Omega(log t) plus convexity/summability conditions (Assumption A.2)
per-agent regret; agents know N and their own ID
communication budget sequence is an input to the algorithm
settings.definition_quote: We consider N agents, each playing the same instance of a K armed stochastic MAB to minimize cumulative regret. ... all agents pull one of the K arms and observe a stochastic Bernoulli reward, independent of everything else. ... The regret of agent i ... is defined as R_T^{(i)} := sum_{t=1}^{T}(mu_1 - mu_{I_t^{(i)}})

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-agent MAB, any communication (full interaction) (lower bound)
unmapped: N agents; lower bound holds for any communication matrix P and even with no communication constraints (full sharing of history)

source.label: thm:full_interaction
source.quote: The regret of any agent $i \in [N]$ after playing arms for $T$ times under any consistent policy played by the agents and any communication matrix $P$ satisfies $\liminf_{T \rightarrow \infty} \frac{\mathbb{E}[R_{T}^{(i)}]}{\ln(NT)} \geq  \left( \frac{1}{N}\sum_{j =2}^{K} \frac{\Delta_j}{\text{KL}(\mu_j,\mu_1)} \right)$

results.notes: KL is Bernoulli KL kl(mu_j, mu_1). The paper also derives the weaker form mu_1(1-mu_1)(1/N) sum 1/Delta_j via standard KL inequalities. Consistency is defined per agent.

source.label: cor:asym_regret
source.quote: Suppose in a system of $N \geq 2$ agents each running Algorithm 1 or 2 with parameters satisfying conditions in Theorems 1 and 3 respectively. Then, for every agent $i \in [N]$ ... $\limsup_{T \rightarrow \infty} \frac{E[R_T^{(i)}]}{\ln(T)} \leq \left( \sum_{j=2}^{\lceil \frac{K}{N} \rceil + 2} \frac{4\alpha}{\Delta_j} \right)$

results.notes: Same statement covers Algorithm 2 (recorded separately as r6).
